hypothesis: Surprise-prioritized replay improves retained, publicly learned conditional predictions after intervening experience relative to equal-budget FIFO/random replay, rather than demonstrating general causal cognition.
research_role: One mechanism-family diagnostic within native learning discovery; not whole Wingless/Yggdrasil architecture optimization

handwritten_diagnostic.events: At most 32 explicitly handwritten public cue/outcome pairs: acquisition, conflicting interference, and return; same chronological stream to every arm
handwritten_diagnostic.report: Do not optimize parameters, select winners or create scientific GO from fixture outcomes

guards: No seeded experimental episodes or Q20/Q21/Q21N-01 roles
No new controller, scheduler, Cloudflare resource, paid API or science dispatch
No edits to Q20 negatives or Q21/Q21N-01 frozen protocol
Retain negative outcomes and every measured baseline, including cases where surprise replay underperforms
Do not call fixed replay policy learned selection or inferred causal abstraction
engineering_checks: All three replay learners use identical observed public history, update rates, buffer capacity and replay step count
Full-history counts receives identical observations; its memory difference must be recorded, not misrepresented as equal-budget
Predictions change only after observed public outcomes and persist in bounded state
Replay options create distinct selected records where informative, without privileged metadata
Deterministic same-source runs match, invalid inputs fail without mutation, memory and observation caps enforced
Source-only tests pass native Windows/Linux; one final repository regression before any merge
science_progression: After independent FORGE FSA first Wingless/Yggdrasil acceptance and new prospective source birth, evaluate multiple learned mechanism families on independent unfamiliar development tasks, equally FIT-trained recurrent, Bayesian, predictive-state and episodic-memory controls with exact matched information and full CPU/RSS/storage. Cross-platform first-use must be admitted. Capacity alternatives 2,4,8 (or other widths) must be frozen as distinct prospective identities BEFORE protected data.
